mapper.select: SELECT pt.*, (dt.device_tmpl_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK\_%') AS isReal FROM point_template pt LEFT JOIN device_template dt ON pt.device_tmpl_id = dt.device_tmpl_id WHERE pt.device_tmpl_id = #{deviceTmplId} AND pt.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pt.point_tmpl_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_template (device_tmpl_id, alarm_code, point_name, point_type, data_type, unit, display_precision) VALUES (#{deviceTmplId}, #{alarmCode}, #{pointName}, #{pointType}, #{dataType}, #{unit}, #{displayPrecision})
mapper.update: UPDATE point_template SET point_name = #{pointName}, point_type = #{pointType}, data_type = #{dataType}, unit = #{unit}, display_precision = #{displayPrecision} WHERE point_tmpl_id = #{pointTmplId}
